newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee co-op stocks 4.38 mln bags in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee co-op stocks 4.38 mln bags in Sept.

text.p: Coffee stocks held by Brazilian co-operatives totalled 4.38 million 60.5 kg bags on September 30, the National Coffee Council (CNC) said in a statement.

This is up from than the 3.87 million bags held by co-operatives as of August 31 and also from the 3.48 million bags held at the same stage last year when producers were bringing in the frost and drought-hit 1995/96 harvest.
It is however below the 5.13 million bags in stock by the end of September 1994.

Co-operatives received 1.61 million bags of coffee during the month of September which is more than twice the 629,786 bags delivered in September last year but is down from the 1.79 million bags received in the same month in 1994.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
